headline: Chase Sapphire Preferred Hotel Credit: Maximizing Value and Unexpected Pricing Differences
reasoning: This topic offers high travel relevance and reader value by detailing how to leverage a significant credit card perk, directly impacting travel costs. It's highly actionable, providing clear steps and strategic advice for cardholders. Both sources are established and credible in the points and miles space, ensuring reliable information for readers.
summary: The Chase Sapphire Preferred card offers a $100 annual hotel credit for bookings made through Chase Travel, effectively offsetting its annual fee. Additionally, it has been discovered that the Sapphire Preferred can sometimes offer better hotel pricing and points redemption value through Chase Travel compared to the more premium Chase Sapphire Reserve card.

source_articles.title: Chase Sapphire Preferred Hotel Credit: Any Catch To This Easy $100 Benefit?
source_articles.excerpt: There’s a lot to love about the Chase Sapphire Preferred Card (learn more), including the card’s great return on spending and bonus categories. One of the other awesome perks worth being aware of is the Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit, which can get you up to $100 of value per year, for eligible bookings through Chase Travel.
